edit_prompt: Edit only the supplied image asset, preserving its landscape 4:3 composition, cobalt-blue and pale cream palette, soft editorial lighting, tactile material, and surreal folded-ribbon concept. Make the blue ceramic cup of dark coffee the unmistakable visual protagonist: enlarge the cup to about 45 percent of image width, show its entire rim, handle and visible coffee surface, and position it around the upper-middle of the composition. Reduce the ribbon into a narrower supporting folded platform beneath the cup, occupying about 55 percent of frame width; retain one readable impossible loop, but it must not dominate the cup. Keep the airiness and an elegant sense of surprise. The cup should look appetizing and tangible; no new toppings or promotional objects. Keep the ribbon abstract, not a letter or logo. No island, ocean, palm trees, miniature landscape or literal copying of the inspiration. No people, identifiable café, text, numbers, logo, watermark, headline or CTA. This is only the image layer; the existing separate text panel, brand and CTA will be reused unchanged by the compositor. This request does not assume pixel-exact preservation outside the changed elements.
hypothesis: Aumentar a saliência da xícara e reduzir a fita pode preservar surpresa e aumentar vontade de conhecer o café. Hipótese baseada na crítica preliminar, antes da nota final.
changes: Somente conteúdo da camada de imagem: xícara maior, fita menor como apoio.
Versão da peça muda; textos, fontes, cores, geometria do layout e CTA permanecem.
